api_version.description: API version. Must be `wyrd/v1` for v1 Cards.

security_schemes.description: Security scheme names or inline descriptors.

AuditSpec.description: Audit artifact or evidence bundle metadata.

CardKind.description: Native Wyrd Card kind plus forward-compatible external catch-all.

oneOf.description: Unknown Card kind with schema hash.

CardRef.description: Reference to a registered Card by kind, name, version, optional space, and optional UID.

space.description: Optional space; omitted means current/default space.

ComponentSource.description: Development-time local source resolved by `lock` or `install`.

DataSpec.description: Pure-data description of a dataset or data product.

EvalSpec.description: Reusable evaluation logic and pass gates.

ExperimentSpec.description: Grouping and comparison context for related runs.

McpSpec.description: MCP server or tool catalog metadata.

Metadata.description: Card metadata common to every kind.

is_eval.description: Whether this metric came from evaluation.

ParameterValue.description: Typed parameter value for experiments, runs, workflows, and tools.

ProtocolProfile.description: Protocol-specific public metadata for an agent or service interface.

Relationships.description: Server-derived relationship summary for graph, UI, policy, imports, and diff.

inbound.description: Inbound references as normalized display strings.

outbound.description: Outbound references as normalized display strings.

RunKind.description: Execution kind recorded as a Run.

uid.description: Run UID. Promoted to `RunUid` in the Runs phase.

ServiceSpec.description: Composition of cards used by an application or deployment.

SkillSpec.description: Skill definition used by agent harnesses.

SpaceName.description: Human-visible namespace for Cards and Runs.

background.description: Whether background execution is allowed by the harness.

system_prompt.description: System prompt or prompt reference text.

ToolSpec.description: Declarative tool definition for agent harnesses.

requires_approval.description: Whether approval is required before use.
